data_protocol.training_source: approved non-FA1B2de source declared in an immutable manifest before fitting

split.unit: whole host/run/scenario groups; never individual events
split.formal_fa1b2de: all 53 playbooks/1796 raw actions remain outside these partitions and are reserved for a later final evaluation

data_protocol.feature_fitting: The adapted schema uses fixed constants; no mean/std or vocabulary is fitted. If a future protocol adds a fitted transform, fit it on train groups only and version the protocol.
data_protocol.label_provenance: Labels must come from the declared training source or controlled generator metadata and are never passed as live features.

negative_sampling.primary: inverse-frequency weighted sampler on training groups only
negative_sampling.candidate: no sampler with class-weighted cross entropy

detector_architecture.input_contract: x float32 [N,32], edge_index int64 [2,E], optional batch int64 [N]
candidate_families: GCNConv primary only at initial training review; GAT/GraphSAGE require a separately declared comparison protocol

predeclared_alternative.loss: class-weighted cross entropy using training-group frequencies

optimization_candidates.selection_rule: If alternatives are evaluated, choose by validation balanced accuracy, then validation binary F1, then lowest validation loss, with the lexicographically first configuration as the final tie-break. Selection uses validation groups only and is frozen before formal evaluation.
optimization_candidates.track_o_parameter_boundary: Do not substitute these candidates into Track O or alter the packaged checkpoint baseline.

randomness.seed_selection: registered before training and never selected from formal results

calibration_policy.default: Use detector argmax over the two logits; no post-hoc probability calibration is performed in R4.
calibration_policy.threshold_changes: Any probability threshold, temperature scaling, or alert policy requires a new protocol version and validation-only selection before formal evaluation.
calibration_policy.formal_outputs: No formal output may alter calibration or this protocol.

checkpoint_identity.checkpoint_sha256: not available until a separately authorized training run; absence is intentional at R4

phase2_contract.architecture: same differentiable GNN-compatible mask optimization and staged solidification semantics
phase2_contract.mer: model-level intervention flip only; not host enforcement
phase2_contract.formal_evaluation: deferred until training, calibration, checkpoint, and adapter gates pass
